# awscc_chime_sip_media_application (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Chime::SipMediaApplication



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `aws_region` (String) The AWS Region in which the SIP media application is created.
- `created_timestamp` (String) The SIP media application creation timestamp, in ISO 8601 format.
- `endpoints` (Attributes List) List of endpoints (Lambda ARNs) specified for the SIP media application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints))
- `name` (String) The name of the SIP media application.
- `sip_media_application_arn` (String) The ARN of the SIP media application.
- `sip_media_application_id` (String) The SIP media application ID.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags assigned to the SIP media application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_timestamp` (String) The time at which the SIP media application was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--endpoints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints`

Read-Only:

- `lambda_arn` (String) Valid Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Lambda function.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `value` (String) The tag value.
